technique_name: Create a story of a young girl who discovers she has magical powers.
description: Once upon a time there was a young girl named Jenny who lived an ordinary life. One day, while out in the woods playing with her friends, Jenny stumbled upon a mysterious cave. Inside the cave, Jenny discovered an old book with ancient writings. She opened the book and began to read. As she read, Jenny felt a strange sensation, as if something were taking hold of her.
